title: OpenAlex (research)
description: Academic papers across every discipline from OpenAlex as a research source, through gohort's built-in OpenAlex search, which rebuilds each paper's abstract. Free, no key.
setup_notes: No key needed. The deployment's mail From address goes with each search, which OpenAlex asks of callers that want its faster pool. Run Test on its row under Admin > Extensions > Connectors, which makes one real search for a common phrase. Then add it under Admin > Extensions > Research Sources, which puts it to use: research asks it on the topics set there (suggested: scientific, technology, education), and a tool name there offers it to agents through query_source. Or pick it under Admin > Capabilities > Web Search as the engine.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; research and Web Search list it by this name.
